findings.problem: Still not fixed. The subject starts with "Last chance", which is on the brand's avoided-words list and doesn't fit our calm voice. It is also 53 characters, and the limit is 50. "Detox your life" also hints at the health claim that was taken out of the body.
findings.fix: Use a calm subject of 50 characters or fewer with no health angle, for example: "Swap to a pre-loved phone this Calm Friday" (42 characters).

findings.problem: Still not fixed. The body says "your last chance", which is an avoided phrase. It also adds pressure that doesn't fit our calm, warm voice.
findings.fix: Say it without pressure, for example: "Calm Friday is a nice time to pick up a pre-loved phone."

findings.problem: Still not fixed. There is a second link ("See tablets too", pointing to /tablets). The rules allow exactly one main link, and it must go to https://easybuy.example/calm-friday.
